spec:
SPARK deep-research initiative — literature/technical research supporting Action #26 (narrow novelty Claims 1&3 before thesis finalization — tracker explicitly wants a *formal* IEEE Xplore/Scopus pass, not just general web search like v18's), the WP2 training benchmark gap (87.81% sensitivity vs ≥90% target, 0.9185 AUC-ROC, due Oct 31 2026), Action #23 dataset-protocol completion, Ch.6 future-work items (#28 camera fusion/#29 cloud archival/#30 duty-cycle + the new v54 aquatic-detection roadmap), and thesis Ch1-2 related-work.

Source of truth: dev_logs/SPARK_TRACKER.md v54, github.com/AaradhyaDT/SPARK main @ 53f194de7cd0679c866d905275b465f80c0d9bfb. Read the tracker's §0/§1/§2 before starting any child track — it is dense and authoritative; do not re-derive facts it already states.

19 disjoint child tracks (see subtasks). Each is a literature/technical RESEARCH question — no code changes, no repo edits, no sync.ps1 invocation from any track. Deliverable per track: a written research memo (findings + citations) via submit_checkpoint result_text. Where the tracker itself calls for formal sourcing (Action #26), prefer IEEE Xplore/Scopus/ACM/peer-reviewed over general web results and say explicitly when a claim rests on the latter. Each child states its own boundary against tracker content already resolved — do not re-litigate those.

Known risk on this board: two already-pending tasks predate tracker v54 and are now stale/mismatched — do NOT claim either as literally written without re-verifying against the current tracker first:
- task_2026-08-12_001 (battery-draw math) — already resolved v36; current R-05 figure is ~110–140mA / ~8–10hr, internally consistent. Nothing left to fix.
- task_2026-08-12_002 (phone display client, spec names MQTT+FastAPI+PostgreSQL) — current locked architecture (§2.1/§2.6) is BLE(bleak)+local JSON store+lightweight REST server (gateway/server.py); Layer-3 phone client is display-only over local network. No MQTT/Postgres anywhere in tracker v54. This task's premise doesn't match the current design — needs re-scoping or closing, not execution as written.

Parent will merge_results once all 19 children report done, for Aaradhya's own synthesis pass into narrowed claim wording, a completed data-collection protocol, and updated Ch.6 draft text, as a separate follow-up task — same two-phase pattern as the prior portfolio-site 8-track analysis (task_2026-08-14_001→010).
